title: Two Truths and a Lie: Developer Edition.
why_read: A lightweight trivia game post with minor tech-history facts, offering essentially no technical substance for engineers.
analysis: This post is a casual 'two truths and a lie' trivia game themed around developer and tech history facts, like the origin of the first computer bug and Git's creation story. It's a fun, low-effort engagement piece rather than anything resembling technical analysis or news. There is no real learning value beyond a few bite-sized historical trivia facts, several of which are common knowledge among experienced developers already. It doesn't fit well in a digest meant to surface substantive technical content.
